entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I... I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it works fine. I just... I changed my mind. To be honest, it was a bit of an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I feel terrible about it, and I really could use the money back.

I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account with the phone number you're calling from. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 11 days ago, on January 17th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. So, can I get a return label?

I've just reviewed the policy for this specific item. Because the VeloBand Pulse links to your personal account upon activation, it has a strict 10-day return window. Since it's now been 11 days, I'm afraid I'm not able to process a refund.
Oh. Oh no, really? I had no idea. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I buy all my gear here. I was really hoping you could make an exception. This is very disappointing.

I truly do understand your frustration, and I can see in your file that you're a VIP member with us. I sincerely appreciate your loyalty. While a direct return isn't possible, I do have an excellent alternative I can offer you.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform where members can sell their gently used gear to other VeloFit enthusiasts. Your VeloBand is in high demand, and you can likely get a great price for it there.
A resale marketplace? I don't know... that sounds complicated. I've never done that before. I'll probably lose a lot of money on it.

It's actually very simple, and we guide you through the whole process. And because you are such a long-standing customer, I'd be happy to waive the standard listing fee for you. As a further thank you, I can also add a $20 credit to your account to use on your next purchase with us.
Wait, you can waive the fee and give me a credit? Oh! That's... that's actually very kind of you. That makes a big difference. Okay, yes, that sounds like a good plan. Thank you, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we found a solution that works. I've just applied the $20 credit to your account, and I'm sending you an email right now with a direct link and simple instructions for the VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
